title: What if Earth started spinning backward? 🌍
subject: earth
description:
Where would you want to live on a backward Earth? 👇

In 2018, climate scientists at the Max Planck Institute for Meteorology reversed Earth's spin in a climate model and ran it for 7,000 years. The Sahara turned green, new deserts spread across the Americas and the Atlantic current that warms Europe moved to the Pacific.

Sources: Eos (AGU), "Reversing Earth's Spin Moves Deserts, Reshapes Ocean Currents" (2018); Live Science, "What If Earth Started Spinning Backward?" (2018); Ziemen et al., EGU General Assembly 2018 abstract EGU2018-8523
tags: what if earth rotated the other way

scenes.text: The Sun would rise in the west.
In 2018, Florian Ziemen's team at the Max Planck Institute reversed Earth's spin in a climate model for 7,000 years.
Winds and ocean currents turned around. The Sahara filled with grass and trees.
New deserts spread across the southeastern United States, Brazil and Argentina.
The Atlantic current that keeps Europe mild moved to the Pacific. Western Europe got brutal winters.
The backward planet ended up with 11 million square kilometers less desert.
